title: Find the vertex of a quadratic function (vertex formula)

section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Analyzing Graphs of Quadratic Functions

sources: Example recipe in the plugin's tests (format 2); method: Bittinger 7e §3.3 Examples 1-3
process_card: Finding the vertex with the vertex formula

let.kn: a h^2 + 2 a h^2 + a h^2 + k

steps.name: compute the x-coordinate with the vertex formula
write the vertex as a point

mistakes.name: dropped the minus in -b/(2a)
mistakes.message: The formula is x = -b/(2a): if b = -6, then -b = 6.

hints.hint: Read a and b with their signs.
hints.why: The vertex formula uses a and b.

hints.step: compute the x-coordinate with the vertex formula
hints.why: The vertex sits on the axis of symmetry, halfway between the zeros.
The vertex is a point on the graph.

hints.step: write the vertex as a point
hints.why: The question asks for a point.
